response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including some JVM-related work (Java/C++ at National Instruments and robotic arms at Altom Consulting), but lacks explicit experience with enterprise Java/Kotlin, Spring, IDE internals, or JVM tooling. Their strengths lie in general software engineering and system design rather than the specific JVM/IDE focus required for this role.
strengths: Strong general software engineering background with experience in diverse tech stacks
Proven ability to design and maintain large-scale systems and developer tools
Demonstrated interest in testing, tooling, and developer-experience optimization
concerns: No explicit experience with Java/Kotlin enterprise development or Spring ecosystem
Limited evidence of work on IDE internals or language tooling
Most recent relevant experience (re:cinq) focuses on AI-agent infrastructure rather than JVM tooling

key_factors.factor: IDE internals and language tooling experience
